name: BatchLeads
shortDescription: Property lists with owner phone numbers and emails. Growth is $119 per month.
longDescription: BatchLeads searches property records and adds owner phone numbers and emails when a property is saved. Growth is $119 per month, Professional is $349, and Scale is $749, with a 7-day trial. SMS is an integration with a provider you bring.
pricingNotes: Growth is $119 per month. Professional is $349. Scale is $749. 7-day trial. SMS uses an outside provider.
bestFor: Building a property list that includes owner phone numbers and emails
notIdealFor: Someone who wants texting included without a separate SMS provider
strength: Growth is $119 per month, and saved properties include owner phone numbers and emails.
weakness: Texting uses an SMS provider you connect yourself, and the 7-day trial becomes a paid plan unless you cancel.

useCaseFit.find-off-market: Saves properties with owner phone numbers and emails, and Growth is $119 per month.
